title: Unsaved dashboard filter indicator: segmented buttons, dual desktop/menu layout, snapshots
answers: How is the dashboard unsaved filters control styled?
Why did filter-bar storybook snapshots change?
body:
DashboardUnsavedChangesIndicator (products/dashboards/frontend/dashboardSettings/DashboardUnsavedChangesIndicator.tsx) renders a joined button group inside a bordered `rounded border-warning` wrapper: status LemonButton (`rounded-l`), action LemonButtons (`border-l border-warning`, `rounded-none` except last `rounded-r`), and a LemonMenu trigger button (`rounded-r border-l`).
The action buttons are hidden via `@max-lg/dashboard-filters:hidden` and the menu trigger via `@min-lg/dashboard-filters:hidden`. Any change to the segment corners or borders must update both variants so the outer radius stays consistent at every width.
Visual changes here alter the Storybook snapshots `products-dashboards-filter-bar--filter-bar--*` and `products-dashboards-filter-bar--unsaved-changes-popover--*` in frontend/snapshots.yml (light and dark hashes), which must be updated in the same PR.
applies: Dashboard filter bar unsaved-changes control and its snapshots
